# Aneil Razvi

> Aneil Razvi is a product design and AI experience leader based in Allen, Texas, with more than 20 years building and scaling design teams, shipping AI-native products, and taking experiences from 0 to 1 across enterprise companies and startups. He is available for fractional design leadership, AI product strategy, design-maturity assessments, advising, and speaking.

## Who he is

Aneil Razvi leads product design and AI experience. His core belief is that design should be sized to a company's maturity: not every organization needs a full design team yet, and the honest, useful move is to build exactly the level of design that starts to pay off, whether that is AI-assisted work, a fractional lead, a small group of independent contractors, an external firm, or an in-house function. He pairs senior design judgment with hands-on building, including AI coding tools, so he can go from strategy to shipped product.

## What he does

- Fractional and interim design leadership for teams that need senior direction without a full-time hire yet.
- AI experience strategy, including human-in-the-loop AI, next-best-action systems, and AI that supports people rather than replacing their judgment.
- Design-maturity assessment: reading where an organization actually is and recommending the right level of design investment, even when the answer is "you do not need me yet."
- Building design functions from zero: standards, design systems, research practice, and operating model.
- 0 to 1 product design and solo founder-level building, end to end.
- Speaking and workshops on AI-native design, design maturity, and building design teams.

## Expertise

AI product design, AI experience strategy, human-in-the-loop AI, product design leadership, design systems, building and scaling design teams, fractional design leadership, design maturity, UX research, 0 to 1 product design, enterprise UX, accessibility, and design operations.

## Selected work

- SPOTIO: built the design function and led AI experience strategy for a B2B field-sales platform used by thousands of teams. https://aneilrazvi.com/spotio-case-study.html
- Cubby: designed, built, and shipped solo, a caregiver-curated video app for teens and adults with autism and IDD, live on the App Store. https://aneilrazvi.com/cubby.html and https://cubbyplaylist.com
- Omnitracs: unified a fragmented global fleet-management platform with a design system and an ML next-best-action framework. https://aneilrazvi.com/omnitracs.html
- SNHU: built a product design department from zero and directed AI and ML learner tools at one of the largest online universities in the U.S. https://aneilrazvi.com/snhu.html
- Kalkomey: drove 225%+ revenue growth through a user-centered pivot in outdoor-safety education and e-commerce. https://aneilrazvi.com/kalkomey.html
- Citi: delivered a bank-wide design system and a first-of-its-kind Apple Watch app. https://aneilrazvi.com/citi.html
- Capital One: led brand creative and UX for a consumer auto-lending product. https://aneilrazvi.com/capital-one.html
- TPN (Omnicom): set an AI-augmented creative-technology vision for Fortune 500 retail brand experiences. https://aneilrazvi.com/tpn.html
- PhzMe: shaped brand, product, and the investor-ready story for an early-stage marketplace startup. https://aneilrazvi.com/phzme.html

Signature topics: designing the AI experience, building design teams, taste and craft at scale, and right-sizing design to company maturity. https://aneilrazvi.com/speaking.html
